005package org.wpilib.math.geometry;
006
007import java.util.Objects;
008import org.wpilib.math.geometry.proto.Twist3dProto;
009import org.wpilib.math.geometry.struct.Twist3dStruct;
010import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
011import org.wpilib.math.linalg.VecBuilder;
012import org.wpilib.math.util.Nat;
013import org.wpilib.util.protobuf.ProtobufSerializable;
014import org.wpilib.util.struct.StructSerializable;
015
016/**
017 * A change in distance along a 3D arc since the last pose update. We can use ideas from
018 * differential calculus to create new Pose3d objects from a Twist3d and vice versa.
019 *
020 * <p>A Twist can be used to represent a difference between two poses.
021 */
022public final class Twist3d implements ProtobufSerializable, StructSerializable {
023  /** Linear "dx" component. */
024  public double dx;
025
026  /** Linear "dy" component. */
027  public double dy;
028
029  /** Linear "dz" component. */
030  public double dz;
031
032  /** Rotation vector x component (radians). */
033  public double rx;
034
035  /** Rotation vector y component (radians). */
036  public double ry;
037
038  /** Rotation vector z component (radians). */
039  public double rz;
040
041  /** Default constructor. */
042  public Twist3d() {}
043
044  /**
045   * Constructs a Twist3d with the given values.
046   *
047   * @param dx Change in x direction relative to robot.
048   * @param dy Change in y direction relative to robot.
049   * @param dz Change in z direction relative to robot.
050   * @param rx Rotation vector x component.
051   * @param ry Rotation vector y component.
052   * @param rz Rotation vector z component.
053   */
054  public Twist3d(double dx, double dy, double dz, double rx, double ry, double rz) {
055    this.dx = dx;
056    this.dy = dy;
057    this.dz = dz;
058    this.rx = rx;
059    this.ry = ry;
060    this.rz = rz;
061  }
062
063  /**
064   * Obtain a new Transform3d from a (constant curvature) velocity.
065   *
066   * <p>See <a href="https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf">Controls
067   * Engineering in the FIRST Robotics Competition</a> section 10.2 "Pose exponential" for a
068   * derivation.
069   *
070   * <p>The twist is a change in pose in the robot's coordinate frame since the previous pose
071   * update. When the user runs exp() on the twist, the user will receive the pose delta.
072   *
073   * <p>"Exp" represents the pose exponential, which is solving a differential equation moving the
074   * pose forward in time.
075   *
076   * @return The pose delta of the robot.
077   */
078  public Transform3d exp() {
079    // Implementation from Section 3.2 of https://ethaneade.org/lie.pdf
080
081    var u = VecBuilder.fill(dx, dy, dz);
082    var rvec = VecBuilder.fill(rx, ry, rz);
083    var omega = GeometryUtil.rotationVectorToMatrix(rvec);
084    var omegaSq = omega.times(omega);
085    double theta = rvec.norm();
086    double thetaSq = theta * theta;
087
088    double A;
089    double B;
090    double C;
091    if (Math.abs(theta) < 1E-7) {
092      // Taylor Expansions around θ = 0
093      // A = 1/1! - θ²/3! + θ⁴/5!
094      // B = 1/2! - θ²/4! + θ⁴/6!
095      // C = 1/3! - θ²/5! + θ⁴/7!
096      // sources:
097      // A:
098      // https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i2d=true&i=series+expansion+of+Divide%5Bsin%5C%2840%29x%5C%2841%29%2Cx%5D+at+x%3D0
099      // B:
100      // https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i2d=true&i=series+expansion+of+Divide%5B1-cos%5C%2840%29x%5C%2841%29%2CPower%5Bx%2C2%5D%5D+at+x%3D0
101      // C:
102      // https://www.wolframalpha.com/input?i2d=true&i=series+expansion+of+Divide%5B1-Divide%5Bsin%5C%2840%29x%5C%2841%29%2Cx%5D%2CPower%5Bx%2C2%5D%5D+at+x%3D0
103      A = 1 - thetaSq / 6 + thetaSq * thetaSq / 120;
104      B = 1 / 2.0 - thetaSq / 24 + thetaSq * thetaSq / 720;
105      C = 1 / 6.0 - thetaSq / 120 + thetaSq * thetaSq / 5040;
106    } else {
107      // A = sinθ/θ
108      // B = (1 - cosθ)/θ²
109      // C = (1 - A)/θ²
110      A = Math.sin(theta) / theta;
111      B = (1 - Math.cos(theta)) / thetaSq;
112      C = (1 - A) / thetaSq;
113    }
114
115    var R = Matrix.eye(Nat.N3()).plus(omega.times(A)).plus(omegaSq.times(B));
116    var V = Matrix.eye(Nat.N3()).plus(omega.times(B)).plus(omegaSq.times(C));
117
118    var translation_component = V.times(u);
119
120    return new Transform3d(
121        new Translation3d(
122            translation_component.get(0, 0),
123            translation_component.get(1, 0),
124            translation_component.get(2, 0)),
125        new Rotation3d(R));
126  }
127
128  @Override
129  public String toString() {
130    return String.format(
131        "Twist3d(dX: %.2f, dY: %.2f, dZ: %.2f, rX: %.2f, rY: %.2f, rZ: %.2f)",
132        dx, dy, dz, rx, ry, rz);
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * Checks equality between this Twist3d and another object.
137   *
138   * @param obj The other object.
139   * @return Whether the two objects are equal or not.
140   */
141  @Override
142  public boolean equals(Object obj) {
143    return obj instanceof Twist3d other
144        && Math.abs(other.dx - dx) < 1E-9
145        && Math.abs(other.dy - dy) < 1E-9
146        && Math.abs(other.dz - dz) < 1E-9
147        && Math.abs(other.rx - rx) < 1E-9
148        && Math.abs(other.ry - ry) < 1E-9
149        && Math.abs(other.rz - rz) < 1E-9;
150  }
151
152  @Override
153  public int hashCode() {
154    return Objects.hash(dx, dy, dz, rx, ry, rz);
155  }
156
157  /** Twist3d protobuf for serialization. */
158  public static final Twist3dProto proto = new Twist3dProto();
159
160  /** Twist3d struct for serialization. */
161  public static final Twist3dStruct struct = new Twist3dStruct();
162}
